review.notes: Full review. Sample: 1.1, 2.1, 2.2, 3.1, 3.2, 4.1, 4.2, each recomputed at degenerate parameters (N = 0, 1, 2; P = 0, 1, 2; beta = 0 and negative) with values in the adversarial table; the N = 2 chain of 4.2 iterated in exact rationals and the fast-mixing bound tested on 512 random real couplings. All 14 source locators confirmed in the three texts (Barra et al. arXiv:1105.2790v3, Bovier-Gayrard arXiv:cond-mat/9607103, Levin-Peres 2nd ed. from an author's page). All 14 copied definitions compared with their owners at the suppliers' heads; 12 cited supplier theorems and 20 library declarations opened. Automatic checks all passed; dependency check 0 problems; Suggested.lean elaborates with sorry only; one-tactic probe closes none of the 10 theorems. One finding (P2): the random-pattern Example of Layer 2 is false at P = 0, beta > 1. One small correction: Mathlib has no metric on functions to Bool.
